description: This Perl script generates a mimetypes configuration based on the system's MIME types, with custom logic for conflict resolution and specific extension handling, creating a sample configuration for a web server or application.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a MIME type for a given file extension in the %extensions hash.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or merges a MIME type for a given extension, resolving conflicts with predefined rules and rules prioritizing 'text/' types.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Prints the MIME type mapping for an extension, appending charset for specific text types.

methods.name: mimecmpvalue
methods.description: Sort key function that sorts MIME types, pushing 'x-' and 'vnd.' types after others.
